benefits_features.Travel benefits:
Complimentary Airport Lounge Visits With complimentary Priority Pass membership, you enjoy access to more than 1,000 airport lounges across the globe. The primary member along with the add-on card get complimentary visits. Priority Pass visits are not included in calendar year.
Cardholders can also enjoy complimentary access to domestic airport lounges through the Regalia Visa Lounge program. The programme provides 12 domestic airport lounge access in a calendar year. 
Travel concierge services (BOC): BOC provides travel concierge services as a service to all Regalia Credit Card, helping them to customize their travel experience.
Insurance: Cardholders are eligible for an air accident death cover of Rs. 1 crore, emergency overseas hospitalization cover of up to Rs. 15 lakh, and credit liability cover of up to Rs. 50 lakh. Comprehensive travel cover: Cardholders are eligible for an air accident death cover of Rs. 1 crore, emergency overseas hospitalization cover of Rs. 15 lakh, and credit liability cover of up to Rs. 50 lakh.

how_tos.How to Avail the Lounge-Access Voucher w:
Serviced Lounge Access Program for HDFC Bank Regalia Credit Card. Use the Sept - Oct period to qualify.
Spend Rs. 1 Lakh or more in a calendar quarter (Jan-Mar, Apr-Jun, Jul-Aug, Sep-Dec) to qualify.
Upon meeting the spending criterion, visit the Regalia SmartBuy page, navigate to Lounge Benefits, and generate your lounge access voucher.
Redeem your voucher via SMS/email and receive the voucher in PDF format, containing EOI code to access lounge access.
Contact the helpline mentioned in your e-vouchers for any concerns while accessing lounge facilities.
how_tos.Redeeming Voucher Steps:
Visit the SmartBuy Regalia portal and log in at [https://offers.smartbuy.hdfcbank.com/Regalia].
Click on the Regalia card tab then select Airport Benefits.
Track your spending in the current quarter under the transactions tab.
Once the milestones are exceeded, proceed with your vouchers.
how_tos.Lounge Access Outside India Using Priori:
Priority Pass access outside India is not based on spends.
Apply for Priority Pass after completing a minimum of retail transactions on your HDFC Bank Regalia Credit Card.
With Priority Pass, you and your add-on member can enjoy up to 4 complimentary lounge access per calendar year per card.
Accessing the complimentary visits will incur a charge of US$27 + GST per visit.
Accessing Lounge Outside India Using Priority Pass:
Present your Priority Pass card upon entering the lounge.
The lounge staff will process your access and issue a record of your Voucher or receipt.
Ensure the correct guest and guest’s visit will be recorded in a documented.
Customers using lounge access within India for accompanying guests, apply accordingly.
There will be charges on your statement post the visit date and won’t accrue Reward Points.
Currency conversion rate as per the live buy/sell exchange rate.

miscellaneous:
HDFC Regalia Credit Card Point Redemption
Reward points earned on your Regalia card expire within 2 years of accumulation. You can redeem your existing points by following the steps below
Visit the dedicated HDFC Regalia page at [hdfcbank.com/cards] and choose from the list of redemption options.
Alternatively, you can also redeem the points after entering the SmartBuy section on the HDFC Bank website on NetBanking.
Select the voucher/reward and confirm your selection, after which the points are redeemed.

faqs.How do I earn reward points on Regalia C: You earn reward points for making transactions using your Regalia Credit Card. Only retail spends are eligible for the reward points. Fuel transactions and EasyEMI transactions are not eligible for reward points. These reward points will have an expiry of 2 years before which they should be redeemed for various gifts available in the rewards catalogue.
faqs.Do I earn reward points for domestic fli: Yes, you earn reward points for domestic and international flight bookings.
faqs.Can I recharge my mobile on the Regalia: Yes, you can access your HDFC Regalia credit card online portal for your prepaid mobile phone.
faqs.How can I make payments for my Regalia c: You can make payments for your HDFC Regalia through multiple payment options like autopay, Internet transfer, Net Banking, mobile banking, etc.
faqs.If I misplaced my Regalia Credit Card, w: If you misplace/lose your card, simply call the HDFC Customer Care division and notify them of the same. Your card will be blocked instantly. Alternatively, you can report it online/offline through your NetBanking account.
faqs.What is the credit limit for HDFC Bank R: The bank decides the credit limit based on your credit score and credit history, among other things.
faqs.When will my HDFC Bank Regalia credit po: Your HDFC Regalia points will expire within 2 years after accumulation.
faqs.How many Regalia points will I earn if I: You will earn 6 reward points if you spend Rs.50,000 with your HDFC Bank Regalia credit card.
